11. ORDINANCE -3 READING ~ Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of MR Medium-Density Residential for
land being annexed to the City of Cheyenne located northwest of and adjacent to the
intersection of Thomas Road and Ridge Road.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn, Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

12. ORDINANCE -3" READING - Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
located south of and adjacent to Rawlins Street, east of Cleveland Avenue.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3° and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

13. ORDINANCE -3" READING ~ Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of MR Medium-Density Residential for
land being annexed to the City of Cheyenne located south of and adjacent to Rawlins Street,
east of Cleveland Avenue.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3“ and final reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

14. ORDINANCE -3" READING ~ Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of AG Agricultural for land being annexed
to the City of Cheyenne located southwest of and adjacent to the intersection of Holland
Court and Ridge Road.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and public comment
was made by Elizabeth Stapel.
